description: This file contains the implementation of the RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand, an immutable class that extends AbstractQueryLiveCommand and implements RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand. It provides methods for creating instances, accessing attribute pointers, setting headers, and generating answer builders, specific to the 'RetrieveAttribute' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable final class implementing RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand, providing an implementation for live query commands related to retrieving attributes in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from a Command object, casting it to RetrieveAttribute.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer indicating the attribute's location.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command with the specified DittoHeaders attached.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates a new builder for handling the command's answer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method for debugging purposes.
